title: LFT Aur KFT Test In Salempur — Kis Ko, Kab Aur Kyun
description: Salempur me LFT aur KFT test kab karayein — bahar se laute kaamgar, sugar-BP wale bujurg aur peeliya me kaunsi jaanch, fasting, aur sample ghar se.
keywords: LFT KFT test at home Salempur
takeaways: Liver aur kidney dono chup rehne wale ang hain. Peeliya ya sujan dikhne tak nuksan aksar kaafi aage badh chuka hota hai — isliye jinhe khatra hai, unke liye LFT aur KFT lakshan se pehle ki jaanch hai.
Salempur belt me teen log sabse zyada is jaanch se chhootte hain: bahar se laute kaamgar, sugar-BP ki dawa wale bujurg, aur peeliya me pehle jhaad-phoonk karane wale ghar.
Roz ki dard ki goli, TB ki dawa, bina parche ke nuskhe aur body-building powder — ye sab liver ya kidney par asar daal sakte hain. Test se pehle doctor aur booking, dono ko inke baare me bataiye.
LFT aur KFT dono ek hi sample me ho jaate hain, aam taur par fasting nahi lagti, aur sample Salempur, Bhatni, Lar ya Majhauli me ghar par liya jaata hai.

sections.heading: LFT Aur KFT — Do Jaanch Jo Chup Rehne Wale Angon Ki Baat Karti Hain
sections.lead: Dard nahi hota, isliye jaanch bhi nahi hoti.
blocks: Salempur ke gaon-kasbon me liver aur kidney ki jaanch zyadatar tab hoti hai jab kuch dikh jaaye — aankhein peeli ho gayi, pair sooj gaye, ya peshab kam hone laga. Dikkat ye hai ki dono ang bahut der tak bina shikayat kiye kaam chalaate rehte hain. Jab tak lakshan aata hai, tab tak jaanch "pakadne" ki jagah "ginne" ka kaam karne lagti hai. LFT aur KFT isi chuppi ko todne wali jaanch hain, aur ye guide wahi batati hai jo LFT test in Salempur ya KFT karane se pehle jaanna chahiye — kis ko, kab aur kyun.

note.title: Ye jaanch ki guide hai, ilaaj ki nahi
note.text: Yahan likha hai ki kis haalat me LFT ya KFT kaam aata hai aur sample se pehle kya dhyaan rakhein. Report ka matlab aur ilaaj doctor tay karta hai. Kisi number ko dekh kar apne aap dawa shuru ya band mat kijiye.

sections.heading: Surat, Mumbai Ya Gulf Se Laute Hain — Liver-Kidney Ki Jaanch Kyun Pehle
sections.lead: Bahar ki naukri ka asar aksar pehle report me dikhta hai, sharir me baad me.
blocks: Salempur, Bhatni aur Lar ki taraf ke bahut se gharon ka kamane wala bahar hai — Surat ki kapda mill, Mumbai ya Delhi ki factory, Punjab ke khet, ya khadi desh ki construction site. Wahan ki zindagi ke chaar hisse aise hain jo seedhe liver aur kidney tak pahunchte hain, aur jinka zikr doctor ko karna chahiye:

list: Garmi me lambi shift aur kam paani — sharir me paani ki kami baar-baar ho to creatinine aur urea upar dikh sakte hain, aur kidney par bojh badhta hai.
Roz ki dard ki goli — kamar, kandhe ya sar ke dard ke liye bina parche ke roz goli lena bahut aam hai. Kuch dard ki goliyan lambe samay me kidney par asar daal sakti hain.
Bahar ka tel wala khana aur kam neend — pet ke aas-paas badhta wazan fatty liver ki taraf le jaata hai, jo aksar sirf SGPT ke thoda badhne se pakad me aata hai.
Sharaab — kuch jagah thakan utaarne ki aadat ban jaati hai. Iska asar LFT me dikhta hai, aur test se pehle ki sharaab report ko aur bigaad deti hai.

blocks: Isliye chhutti me ghar aayein to routine checkup me LFT aur KFT ko jagah dijiye, aur doctor ko saaf bataiye ki bahar kya kaam tha, kaunsi goli roz chalti thi, aur sharaab kitni. Ye baat sharm ki nahi, jaanch ki hai — doctor wahi dekhta hai jo use bataya jaata hai.

note.title: Videsh ke visa ka medical alag cheez hai

sections.heading: Sugar Ya BP Ki Dawa Chal Rahi Hai — Kidney Test Salempur Me Saal Me Kab
sections.lead: Creatinine normal hone ka matlab ye nahi ki kidney par koi asar nahi.
blocks: Sugar aur BP kidney ki sabse badi, aur sabse chup, dushman hain. Salempur ke bahut se gharon me bujurg in dono ki dawa saalon se kha rahe hain, aur kidney test tabhi hota hai jab pairon me sujan aa jaaye. Us waqt tak creatinine badh chuka hota hai. Isse pehle pakadne ke liye teen cheezein dekhi jaati hain:

list: Urine microalbumin (ya albumin-creatinine ratio) — sabse pehla ishara. Creatinine abhi normal ho tab bhi ye badh sakta hai. Sugar ke mareez me saal me ek baar, doctor ke kahe anusar.

Creatinine aur eGFR — creatinine se umar aur ling ke hisaab se eGFR nikaala jaata hai, jo kidney ki chhaanne ki kshamta ka andaza deta hai. Bujurgon me creatinine "normal" dikhne par bhi eGFR kam ho sakta hai, isliye doctor dono dekhta hai.
Potassium — BP ki kuch dawa aur kidney ki kamzori me potassium badh sakta hai. Doctor ne electrolytes likhe hain to unhe chhodiye mat.

blocks: Kitni baar karana hai, ye doctor tay karta hai; aam taur par sugar ke mareez me saal me ek baar KFT aur microalbumin, aur kidney par asar dikh chuka ho to usse jaldi. Har baar ek hi lab se karaiye — creatinine me chhota sa farak bhi maayne rakhta hai, aur do alag lab ke number ki tulna bharosemand nahi hoti.

sections.heading: Peeliya Ki Jaanch Salempur — Jhaad-Phoonk Se Pehle LFT
sections.lead: Aastha apni jagah hai. Jaanch ka din aage mat badhaiye.
blocks: Purvanchal ke gaon me peeliya ke saath ek purani parampara judi hai — "peeliya utarwana", maala pehnana, ya kisi jaankar ke paas le jaana. Kisi ki aastha par sawaal uthana is guide ka kaam nahi hai. Lekin ek baat saaf kehna zaroori hai: peeliya ek bimari nahi, kai bimariyon ka ek jaisa dikhne wala lakshan hai. Kuch me aaram apne aap aa jaata hai, aur kuch me der karna khatarnak hota hai. Farak sirf jaanch batati hai.

list: LFT — bilirubin kitna hai, aur SGPT-SGOT kitne badhe hain. Yahi batata hai ki peeliya kis taraf ka lagta hai.
Hepatitis A IgM aur Hepatitis E IgM — ganda paani is ilaake me peeliya ki sabse aam wajah hai, khaas kar barsaat ke baad.
HBsAg (Hepatitis B) — doctor zaroorat samjhe to.
CBC — kuch peeliya khoon ke tootne se hota hai, jo CBC me dikhta hai.

note.title: In haalaton me usi din doctor ya aspatal
note.text: Garbhwati mahila ko peeliya; naye janme bachche ki twacha ya aankh peeli; peeliya ke saath behoshi jaisi susti, baat samajh na aana, khoon ki ulti ya kaali latrine; ya pet me paani bhar kar pet phoolna. In me ghar par sample ka intezaar nahi kiya jaata.

blocks: LFT ke liye aam taur par fasting nahi lagti, isliye mareez ko bhookha rakh kar subah ka intezaar karne ki zaroorat nahi. Aur khaane-peene me kya band karna hai, ye bhi doctor se poochhiye — gaon me chalne wali "sab band" wali salah se kamzor mareez aur kamzor ho jaata hai.

sections.heading: LFT KFT Test At Home Salempur — Fasting, Taiyaari Aur Visit
sections.lead: Ek sample, das minute, aur report phone par.
blocks: LFT aur KFT dono ek hi baar ke khoon ke sample se ho jaate hain, aur aam taur par in me fasting nahi lagti. Fasting tab lagti hai jab saath me fasting sugar ya lipid profile bhi likha ho — jo sugar-BP ke mareez me aksar hota hai. Aise me slot subah ka rakhiye, taaki sab ek hi sample me ho jaaye.

list: Saada paani peete rahiye. Paani ki kami se nas milna mushkil hota hai aur urea-creatinine jhoothe taur par badhe hue aa sakte hain.
Microalbumin likha ho to peshab ka sample bhi dena hai — container visit me milta hai. Subah ka peshab behtar rehta hai; ghanton pehle bhar kar mat rakhiye.
Rozana ki BP-sugar ki dawa aam taur par apne samay par lijiye, jab tak doctor mana na kare — lekin fasting sample se pehle sugar ki dawa kab leni hai, ye apne doctor se pooch lijiye.
Booking ke waqt dawa ki list aur parche ki photo dijiye.

blocks: Trained phlebotomist ID card ke saath ghar aata hai aur sample aapke saamne leta hai. Slot subah 6 baje se shuru hote hain, home collection ₹100 per booking hai, payment sample ke waqt cash ya UPI se hota hai, aur report 24 ghante ke andar WhatsApp aur email par PDF me aati hai.

sections.heading: Report Me Ek Number Upar Aaya — Ghabraane Se Pehle Ye Teen Sawaal
sections.lead: Ek number ek photo hai. Faisla disha se hota hai.
blocks: LFT ya KFT ki report me ek-aadh number reference range se thoda bahar hona bahut aam hai, aur har baar bimari ka matlab nahi hota. Doctor ke paas jaane se pehle ye teen sawaal khud se poochh lijiye — doctor bhi yahi poochhega:

list: Sample se pehle kya hua tha? Pichhli raat sharaab, bhaari mehnat, paani ki kami, ya koi nayi dawa — ye sab ek din ke liye number badal sakte hain.
Kitna bahar hai? Range se thoda upar aur kai guna upar, do bilkul alag baatein hain.
Pichhli report kya kehti hai? Number dheere-dheere badh raha hai, ya pehli baar dikha hai — isi se tay hota hai ki dobara kab dekhna hai.

blocks: Dobara test kitne din baad karana hai, ye doctor batata hai — aam taur par halke badlaav me kuch hafte baad, aur tab bhi usi lab se. Pichhli report ki PDF saath rakhiye; bina purani report ke doctor ke paas sirf aadhi kahani hoti hai.

note.title: In report ke saath usi din doctor
note.text: Bahut badha bilirubin ke saath susti ya ulti; bahut badha creatinine ke saath peshab kam hona ya saans phoolna; ya potassium bahut upar-neeche likha ho. In me agle hafte ki appointment ka intezaar nahi karte.

faqs.question: Salempur me LFT aur KFT test ke liye khaali pet rehna padta hai?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par nahi. LFT aur KFT bina fasting ke ho jaate hain. Agar parche par saath me fasting sugar ya lipid profile bhi likha hai, to 10 se 12 ghante ki fasting rakhiye aur subah ka slot lijiye, taaki sab ek hi sample me ho jaaye. Saada paani peete rahiye.

faqs.question: Creatinine normal hai — kya sugar ke mareez ki kidney theek maan lein?
faqs.answer: Zaroori nahi. Kidney par asar ka sabse pehla ishara urine microalbumin deta hai, jo creatinine normal rehte hue bhi badh sakta hai. Bujurgon me doctor creatinine ke saath eGFR bhi dekhta hai. Sugar ke mareez me saal me ek baar KFT aur microalbumin aam salah hai — antaraal doctor tay karta hai.

faqs.question: Aankhein peeli hain — pehle jhaad-phoonk karayein ya jaanch?
faqs.answer: Jaanch ka din aage mat badhaiye. Peeliya kai alag bimariyon me hota hai aur kuch me der khatarnak hai. LFT aur Hepatitis A/E ki jaanch ghar par sample se ho jaati hai. Garbhwati mahila, naya bachcha, ya peeliya ke saath behoshi, khoon ki ulti ya bahut susti ho, to usi din aspatal jaaiye.

faqs.question: Gulf se laute hain — kya aap visa ka medical bhi karte hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Videsh ke visa ka medical sirf tay kiye gaye centre par hota hai aur wo hamari service nahi hai. Hum apni sehat ki routine jaanch — jaise LFT, KFT, sugar, lipid aur CBC — ka sample ghar se lete hain.

faqs.question: TB ki dawa chal rahi hai — LFT kitne din par karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Ye aapka doctor batayega. TB ki dawa me doctor aksar beech-beech me LFT dekhta hai, khaas kar agar bhookh na lage, ulti ho ya aankhein peeli lagein. Aise lakshan hon to agli tay taareekh ka intezaar mat kijiye, doctor ko turant bataiye. Dawa khud se band nahi karni.

faqs.question: SGPT thoda badha aaya hai aur koi takleef nahi — kya ye ghabraane ki baat hai?
faqs.answer: Aksar nahi. Pichhli raat sharaab, bhaari mehnat, kuch dawaiyan ya fatty liver se SGPT thoda badh sakta hai. Report doctor ko dikhaiye, pichhli report ho to wo bhi, aur dobara test doctor ke kahe samay par usi lab se karaiye.

faqs.question: Bhatni ya Lar me rehte hain — LFT KFT ka sample ghar se liya jaayega?
faqs.answer: Haan, Salempur kasbe ke saath Bhatni, Lar, Bhatpar Rani, Bhagalpur, Majhauli Raj, Rampur Karkhana aur Barhaj me bhi sample ghar se liya jaata hai. Aapka gaon naam se na dikhe to booking se pehle ek call kar lijiye.
